map.label: Course map
map.masteryHint: The share of this unit's graded questions whose latest answer was right, without the opening question; a placed-out unit shows full until it has a graded answer.
map.cleaned: Files cleaned up on {{date}}: exercise files, caches and sessions are gone; the record stays.

plan.heading: How I plan to teach this · ranked for you
plan.always: Always on, whatever you pick: hints before answers, confidence-rated checks, spaced reviews.
plan.placementInfo: About 8 questions, harder or easier depending on your answers. It decides where the course starts and what you can skip.
plan.preparedInfo: Accepting builds the course map; opening a unit on it produces that unit's lesson plan.

concept-map.title: Concept map and teach-back
concept-map.summary: You get a map of the field and its prerequisites, learn one concept at a time through questions, and prove it by explaining it back.

crossover.title: Crossover from what you know
crossover.summary: Every new idea is bridged from a skill you already have, with warnings where old habits mislead.

hands-on.title: Hands-on project
hands-on.summary: You predict, run and change real code or real tool sessions. Lessons are built around a small project you care about.

leveled-course.title: Leveled course
leveled-course.summary: A long course in levels with tracked progress: reading and listening, writing, grammar and vocabulary, and fluency practice in balance.

worked-examples.title: Worked example, then solo
worked-examples.summary: You study a fully solved example, then finish partly solved ones, then solve alone.

chat.label: Tutor chat
chat.changeHint: Tell the tutor what to change: leave a topic out, add one, reorder, make it shorter…

profile.intro: A profile keeps one person's courses, reviews and what the tutor knows about them. No password; anyone using this browser can switch profiles.
profile.knows: What the tutor knows about you
profile.nothing: Nothing yet. The tutor records what you tell it in interviews.
profile.factsScope: These facts are used in every course of this profile. Facts about one course stay with that course.
profile.name: Name
profile.noPassword: No password. Anyone using this browser can switch profiles.
profile.sketchHelp: The tutor's own figures are shown with a sketchy stroke. Off, they are shown as drawn. Illustrations from an art pack always stay as they are.
profile.commandsScope: Every command the tutor ran, every Run you pressed, and every command you allowed or refused internet for, across your courses.
profile.learnerHelp: The tutor interviews you, places you and teaches you unit by unit.
profile.teacherHelp: The course designer interviews you about your class and writes a lesson plan per unit: openings, explanations, exercises with solutions, quick checks with keys, misconceptions, timing. Nothing is taught to you; your courses stay yours.

network.label: The tutor asks to use the internet
network.explain: Runs once, in the sandbox, for up to two minutes. It can reach public internet sites over HTTP and HTTPS; it cannot reach this computer or private network addresses, and it can write only in this course's own folders. It runs the files of the workspace as they are now.

commands.intro: Newest first. The tutor's own checks, your Run on exercises, and commands with internet after you decided.
